concepts.title: A — Coral Stub
concepts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: original pistol visual concept sheet for an irreverent top-down city video game; a fictional game prop, not a manufacturing drawing.
Style: smooth stylized 3D, chunky bevels, simple readable massing. Match an ordinary contemporary city with dark vibrant cyberpunk night lighting: navy shadows, restrained cyan/magenta accents, warm coral highlights. Do not imitate a real firearm or real brand.
Composition: one consistent pistol design shown in a clean landscape concept board on muted blue-grey. Large side profile at left pointing right, large true directly-overhead view at upper right with muzzle pointing toward top of page, clean three-quarter view at lower right. Small solid black side and overhead silhouettes along bottom. Label views simply SIDE, TOP, THREE-QUARTER, SILHOUETTE. Show complete objects with generous separation, no cropping. All views depict the same design. Side views retain recognizable short pistol grip and trigger-guard shape, no long magazine, stock or scope.
Readability: top surface has two or three large high-contrast color blocks, not fine glowing lines. Broad short barrel and clearly wider rear/slide contour. Design intended to remain recognizable at only approximately 14-18 pixels long from a vertical-down north-up perspective camera, height 47 m, FOV 42 degrees, viewport 1280x800. Those conditions are a design target, not a verified render. Include small overhead color thumbnail beside the black silhouettes. No characters, hands, city illustration, muzzle flash, bullets, exploded view, dimensions, internal mechanics, performance claims, technical assembly instructions, logos, real brands or watermark. Use calm neutral studio light with faint cyan/magenta rim light, enough brightness to see form.
Original direction A: compact chunky squared slide with softened corners, a broad warm coral upper shell over a very dark petrol lower frame and short angled dark grip. One broad cream rear-top patch and a tiny cyan status patch. Slightly blunt stubby muzzle face; compact toy-like attitude but unmistakably a pistol. Simple everyday street sidearm silhouette. Avoid holes, numerous vents, complicated panel cuts and tactical clutter.
Text title (verbatim): "A — Coral Stub". Add a discreet footer "VISUAL CONCEPT — NOT CAMERA VALIDATED".
